theorems.statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) [Δ.FiniteIndex], (-1 : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∈ Δ → ∃ B : InnerProductSpace.Core ℂ (CuspForm Δ 2), ∀ (F : Set UpperHalfPlane), MeasurableSet F → (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Δ ∧ γ • z ∈ F ∧ ∀ δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, δ ∈ Δ → δ • z ∈ F → δ = γ ∨ δ = -γ) → ∀ f g : CuspForm Δ 2, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f g) F (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane) ∧ B.inner f g = MeasureTheory.integral ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane).restrict F) (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f g)
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted effective-domain, integrability, domain-transfer, and definiteness dependencies to construct one Petersson core valid for every admissible domain.
